name: Kawasaki GPz750 / GPz1100
engine: 738 or 1089 cc air-cooled inline four, carbs or early fuel injection
intro: Kawasaki's early 80s sport fours. Some GPz1100s have an early fuel injection system that takes patience to sort out.

G: Check which fuel system you have. Early injected GPz1100s need the sensors and wiring checked, not a carb rebuild.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
